actual_review: Read complete two-path diff, six normal control bodies, ignored cost probe and preserved rusqlite cache implementation.
Recomputed both candidate source sizes and SHA256; matched the frozen v1 manifest.
Checked exact old entry-point flags in independent Gfff source and the original immediate/deferred FTS boundary.
findings: Only rebuild_dependency_batches=true selects the new helper; ordinary/public original loop remains in false branch.

Each fixed base INSERT is prepared lazily after source_json and compression selection. FTS is prepared only after the base row and last_insert_rowid. SQL, parameters and error mapping retain their original order.

Each execute result is mapped before unconditional clear_bindings, matching the old cached handle drop behavior without adding a reset. Two handles end at the file helper and retain no previous chunk parameters.

The cost baseline retains exact original prepare_cached/execute/drop per row. Four input classes and20 alternating rounds compare complete typed base/FTS rows; in-memory mechanism times exclude begin/readback/rollback.
Statement-cache recency may differ as intended. Neither independent review nor static cache-call reduction establishes a full-staging or scale speedup.
